component.name: Obrol
component.summary: Native, lightweight WhatsApp client for Linux (GTK3 + Go)
Klien WhatsApp native & super ringan untuk Linux (GTK3 + Go)

description.p: Obrol is a truly native WhatsApp client: no Electron, no browser tab — a small GTK3 application in Go that links as a companion device via the WhatsApp multi-device protocol (whatsmeow), with end-to-end encryption intact and a local SQLite archive.

Features: chat list with pin/archive/mute, multi-select with bulk actions, stickers (animated WebP decode + sticker creator from any image or screenshot), group management, reactions, replies, edits, pins, presence (online/last seen/typing), desktop notifications, tray icon (StatusNotifierItem), and an Indonesian-first interface with automatic system-language detection.

Obrol adalah klien WhatsApp yang benar-benar native: tanpa Electron, tanpa tab browser — aplikasi GTK3 kecil berbahasa Go yang menaut sebagai perangkat pendamping lewat protokol multi-perangkat WhatsApp (whatsmeow), dengan enkripsi end-to-end tetap utuh dan arsip SQLite lokal.
